summary.name: Gemini platform (Google Cloud Vertex AI)
summary.one_liner: Google Cloud's enterprise platform for building, scaling, governing and optimizing AI agents and for accessing Gemini and other models, plus MLOps tooling for training, tuning and deploying ML models.
use_cases: build enterprise AI agents grounded in company data
prototype generative AI applications with Gemini
compare and evaluate generative AI models
train, tune and deploy custom ML models
run batch or online predictions from registered models
classify, summarize or extract information from text with prompts
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Gemini platform as Google Cloud's platform for building, scaling, governing and optimizing enterprise agents grounded in enterprise data. Agent Studio lets users design, test and manage prompts for Gemini models using text, code, images or video, and Gemini models can be called through the Gemini API with code samples in Python, JavaScript, Java, Go and Curl. Model Garden offers Google's Gemini models, third-party models such as Anthropic's Claude, and open models like Gemma, with tuning options. The platform also includes Model Evaluation, notebooks (Colab Enterprise or Workbench) integrated with BigQuery, custom training with user-chosen frameworks, Pipelines, Model Registry, Feature Store and model monitoring for skew and drift. The page also mentions Google Antigravity as a desktop app and CLI for steering and orchestrating agents.
notable: Model Garden offers Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and open models like Gemma in one place
Agent Development Kit (ADK) support for building agents
Usage-based pricing with $300 new-customer free credits
caveats: Custom model training is priced by machine type, region and accelerators and requires contacting sales for estimates
Pricing is usage-based and varies by model and infrastructure; costs are not fully predictable from the page
Page states users should not enter sensitive, confidential or personal information and must be 18 or older to use the service
